title: The Nervous System
text: The nervous system is the organ system that coordinates voluntary and involuntary actions by transmitting signals to and from different parts of the body. It consists of two main parts: the central nervous system (CNS), comprising the brain and spinal cord, and the peripheral nervous system (PNS), comprising all other neural elements. Neurons are the basic units of the nervous system, transmitting electrical signals (action potentials) along their axons. Synapses are junctions between neurons where chemical neurotransmitters relay signals. The human brain contains approximately 86 billion neurons and an estimated 100 trillion synaptic connections, making it one of the most complex structures known.
